# mushroomdb

> The association engine for apps and AI agents. An embedded Rust graph database
> where edges are DECLARED, not inserted: you write rules, the db creates,
> maintains, and retracts edges automatically and can explain() why any edge exists.

## What it is

mushroomdb is a single-file-dependency embedded graph database for Rust, Python,
and TypeScript. Its differentiator is incremental linking rules: declare a predicate
once (cosine similarity, field equality, Jaccard overlap, FK match, geographic radius,
numeric range), and every subsequent write maintains the matching edges without any
manual bookkeeping. Edges are retracted automatically when properties diverge.

Primary audiences:
1. AI agents and coding assistants building association graphs and agent memory
   (built-in MCP server, explainable links, per-node history, hybrid search).
2. Small internal apps where relationships and matching are the product.

## Install / build

```sh
# Rust library (crates.io)
cargo add mushroomdb            # embedded GraphDb API
# Rust CLI + server (crates.io)
cargo install mushroomdb-cli    # `mushroomdb` binary: serve/query/demo/schema

# Python (from source until the PyPI wheel ships with the next release tag)
cd bindings/python
python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip maturin
.venv/bin/maturin develop

# TypeScript client (from repo until the npm publish lands)
npm install /path/to/graph-db/clients/typescript
```

Docker (local build):
```sh
docker build -t mushroomdb:local .
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 -e MUSHROOMDB_TOKEN=secret mushroomdb:local
```

## Quick start (CLI)

```sh
mushroomdb demo ./db      # ingest demo graph (10 Orgs, 20 Projects, 30 People)
mushroomdb serve ./db     # HTTP server + UI at http://127.0.0.1:8080
mushroomdb mcp ./db       # stdio MCP JSON-RPC server for agent tools
```

## Key API (Rust)

```rust
use core_api::{GraphDb, RuleDef, Predicate};

let mut db = GraphDb::open(&path)?;

// Insert nodes
db.insert_node("Person", "alice", vec![
    ("skills".into(), Value::List(vec!["graph".into(), "rust".into()])),
    ("embedding".into(), Value::List(vec![0.9f64.into(), 0.2.into()])),
])?;

// Declare a rule — fires on every subsequent write
db.create_rule(RuleDef {
    name: "skill_fit".into(),
    src_label: "Person".into(),
    dst_label: "Org".into(),
    predicate: Predicate::Overlap { field: "skills".into(), min: 0.5 },
    edge_type: "FIT".into(),
    weight_prop: Some("score".into()),
    max_edges: Some(5),
    approximate: false,
})?;

// Cypher query
let rows = db.query("MATCH (p:Person)-[r:FIT]->(o:Org) RETURN p, o, r.score", &Default::default())?;

// Explain why an edge exists
let exps = db.explain("alice", "acme")?;  // [{rule, edge_type, weight, ...}]

// Per-node change history (WAL horizon since last snapshot)
let history = db.node_history("alice")?;

// Schema-as-code (idempotent apply)
let diff = db.apply_schema(&schema)?;  // SchemaDiff { created, updated, unchanged }

// Hybrid search (fulltext + vector via RRF)
let hits = db.search_hybrid("rust graph", "bio", Some(&embedding), "embedding", Some("Person"), 10)?;

// Subscribe to query results (incremental, allowlisted Cypher subset)
let sub = db.subscribe_query("MATCH (p:Person)-[:FIT]->(o:Org) RETURN p, o LIMIT 20")?;

// Node mask (ACL-scoped read)
let mask = NodeMask::from_keys(&db, ["alice", "bob"]);
let rows = db.query_masked("MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p", &Default::default(), &mask)?;
```

## MCP tools (12 total)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `query` | Cypher query; `mask` param for ACL-scoped read |
| `ingest_json` | Batch ingest nodes from JSON array |
| `create_rule` | Declare a derivation rule |
| `explain` | Explain rule-derived edges between two nodes |
| `explain_association` | Alias of explain; semantic name for agent workflows |
| `upsert_entity` | Insert or update a node by key (no existence check needed) |
| `find_similar` | (1) Vector search via HNSW; (2) edge-traversal neighbors |
| `hybrid_search` | RRF over fulltext + vector results |
| `neighborhood` | Multi-hop graph traversal |
| `node_info` | Node key, label, properties |
| `node_edges` | Incident edges with derived flag |
| `stats` | Live node/edge/rule counts |

Claude Desktop config:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mushroomdb": {
      "command": "mushroomdb",
      "args": ["mcp", "/path/to/your/db"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Six predicate kinds

| Predicate | Matches when |
|---|---|
| `KeyMatch` | source field value equals destination node key (FK) |
| `FieldEqual` | named field is equal on both nodes |
| `Overlap` | Jaccard similarity on list fields exceeds min threshold |
| `NumericWithin` | absolute numeric difference within tolerance |
| `GeoRadius` | Haversine distance on [lat, lon] within km |
| `VectorSimilar` | cosine similarity on float arrays exceeds min |

Predicates compose via `All(...)` (AND, score = min) and `Any(...)` (OR, score = max), nestable to depth 4.

`approximate: true` on `VectorSimilar` uses in-tree HNSW (recall min 0.90, mean 0.998 at 5k/dim 1536, fixed-seed probe).

## Cypher subset

Supported: MATCH, WHERE (AND/OR/NOT, IN, IS NULL/IS NOT NULL), RETURN (DISTINCT), ORDER BY,
SKIP, LIMIT, WITH pipeline, OPTIONAL MATCH, UNWIND, CREATE, MATCH…SET, MATCH…DELETE,
MATCH…DETACH DELETE, MERGE (ON CREATE SET / ON MATCH SET), variable-length paths (*min..max, max 10),
shortestPath, aggregations (COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX, grouped), query parameters ($name),
scalar functions (toLower, toUpper, size, coalesce, type(r), abs, round).

Not supported: CASE, subqueries, UNION, multi-statement BEGIN/COMMIT transactions.

## Storage

- Dense-id WAL with per-commit fsync; configurable FsyncPolicy (strict/batched/relaxed)
- V8 mmap snapshot (v0.2+): 11 rkyv sections (TOPOLOGY, COLUMNS, IDS, SYMS, META,
  EDGE_PROPS, HNSW, PROVENANCE, RULES_META, VIEWS, IVF_STATE); zero-copy open via
  mmap; no heap allocation for section data; O(1) per-query section access
- V5/V6/V7 snapshots auto-migrated to V8 on open; V3/V4 rejected
- Single writer, many readers (RwLock-backed SharedDb)
- RAM-bound; design target 10M nodes (~5–15 GiB with properties)
- 100k nodes (~10M derived edges), V8 snapshot open: **0.02 s, 31–41 MiB RSS**
  (warm file cache, cold process; measured 2026-08-28, Apple M4 Pro, release build)
- 100k nodes, WAL-only open: ~8.16 min (HNSW re-fitting dominates; measured 2026-08-24)
- V8 snapshot size: 1.8 GiB (same 100k dataset; 18% smaller than V5's 2.2 GiB)
- mushroomdb verify <db-dir>: CRC32 audit of all 12 sections; 0.26 s on 1.8 GiB; exits 2 on mismatch

## Limitations (be honest)

- RAM-bound (mmap is read-only for the snapshot base; in-flight writes are in-memory)
- Single writer (no multi-writer, no clustering, no Neo4j parity)
- No differential dataflow
- Dense patterns >1M intermediate rows require LIMIT
- No multi-statement interactive transactions in v1
- V8 open numbers (0.02 s / 31–41 MiB) are warm-file-cache, cold-process; cold-cache
  numbers not measured (require sudo purge)
- Migration footprint (V5→V8) at 100k nodes: ~30 s, peak ~54 GB VM pressure; run
  mushroomdb migrate offline on constrained hosts
- Pre-1.0 format policy: snapshot/WAL formats may change between v0.x minor versions
